summary: Restore the pre-premium live forest after the premium family missed visual preference and regressed the matched 4K A/B benchmark.
areas: Restore the pre-premium live forest catalog, production resources, loaders, and impostor shader
Remove the premium-only live reviewer while retaining the isolated premium source package and A/B comparison evidence
Actual Standard-mountain restored-forest review at near, mid, far, and dither-transition distances

physics.reason: The 120 Hz solver, input, terrain contacts, collision candidates, and skier state are unchanged; only renderer-owned tree resources are restored.

world.reason: The 4 m terrain and packed physical tree placement authority are unchanged; the live renderer returns to the exact pre-premium meshes, materials, LOD assets, impostors, manifests, and branch definitions.

data.reason: No replay, race, save, record, ghost, or compatibility schema is changed by the presentation-only restoration.

mountains.reason: The v15 physical mountain and 4 m terrain data are unchanged.

races.reason: Race definitions and route identity are unchanged.

records.reason: Record eligibility and storage are unchanged.

ghosts.reason: Replay input and ghost playback schemas are unchanged.

caches.reason: Physical and scenery cache identities are retained; this restoration uses the established pre-premium runtime asset and import contract.

checks.details: Native D3D12 forest-preparation regression passed 3,845 checks after input capture; restored catalog, models, imports, material routes, shadows and placement contracts passed. Evidence: artifacts/fps_optimization/forest_preparation_checks.json and artifacts/guarded/forest-restore-preparation/guard.json.

Targeted forest regressions passed 669 checks: density/LOD 384, dynamics 20, colorful catalog/placement 200 and bounded forest map contracts 65. This is functional regression evidence, not an FPS measurement. Evidence: artifacts/forest_restore/regression-headless/results.json.

checks.command: ./scripts/run_guarded.ps1 -FilePath ./godotw.ps1 -Arguments @('--script','tests/live_forest_restoration_playtest.gd','--','--standard','--output=artifacts/forest_restore/rendered') -Label forest-restore-rendered-review -WorkloadMode Shared -FullMountain -FullMountainReason 'Short rendered Standard-mountain review of restored live forest at production LOD bands and dither transitions; no performance measurement.'
checks.details: Actual D3D12 Standard v15 review captured 20 frames at 1920x1080. It confirmed all 30 restored assets across eight families, zero premium catalog entries, legacy FC_Tree/FC_Broadleaf detail and FC_Impostor routes at the High 95 m and 280 m dither bands, and an unchanged physical-world hash. Evidence: artifacts/forest_restore/rendered/review.json and guarded receipt.

checks.command: No new FPS benchmark requested for restoration
checks.details: The decision is based on the preserved matched 4K A/B evidence that the premium family regressed performance. The bounded functional and rendered checks make no new frame-time or FPS claim.
